note: accessKey.updateSpendingLimit sets BOTH limit and remainingInPeriod (TIP-1011: must not change period/periodEnd). Used to restore the 20-unit ceiling after an interrupted ceiling run consumed 15 units; period end unchanged. Recorded reset tx is the second, identical update (0xf472...); the first reset call confirmed the state change (remaining 5,000,000 -> 20,000,000).
